WITH l AS (SELECT * FROM budget_monthly ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 1), p AS (SELECT * FROM power_monthly ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 1), w AS (SELECT * FROM water_monthly ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 1), m AS (SELECT * FROM migration_monthly ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT l.*, p.demand_kw,p.supply_kw,p.outage_fraction,p.contract_mode,w.capacity,w.demand,w.load_ratio,w.failure_rate,m.population,m.net FROM l CROSS JOIN p CROSS JOIN w CROSS JOIN m
